title: Treasure Map Destruction (Constructive Version)
statement: Treasure was buried on a nonempty subset of n islands arranged in a line, and for every island the distance to the nearest treasure island was recorded; some recorded entries were later destroyed and replaced by -1. Given the damaged array of up to 2*10^5 entries, the task is to output any nonempty set of treasure islands consistent with every surviving distance, or report that no such set exists.
